notes.title: An Update Regarding Broilers Future
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone, 
I want to take a moment to address something important about Broilers. As many of you know, the original creator entrusted me with its future. However, they’ve been absent online for quite some time, and based on what they shared with me about their circumstances, I’m deeply concerned for their well-being.

Out of respect for them and their incredible work, I’ve been hesitant to make any changes or updates to the game. I also don’t feel comfortable continuing to sell it without knowing how they would feel about that. My priority is to honor their vision and legacy while ensuring Broilers remains accessible to those who love it.

As a result, all planned updates are no longer in development. In the coming months, Broilers will transition to a free-to-play game with no microtransactions.
This isn’t the end of Broilers as an idea—it’s simply a step toward preserving what made it special. Thank you for your understanding and for all the support you’ve given.
Till we battle again,
 Ajwct

notes.title: Exciting News: "Broilers" Relaunch Under New Ownership
notes.notes:
Exciting News: "Broilers" Relaunch Under New Ownership

Dear Broilers Community,

We are delighted to announce the relaunch of "Broilers" under the new ownership of Bloxhill! As passionate gamers and developers, we are committed to bringing fresh energy and innovative ideas to the game you love.

As part of our relaunch, we are introducing several exciting updates:
-Ukrainian Language Support: We understand the importance of accessibility and are proud to offer full support for Ukrainian , making "Broilers" more enjoyable for our diverse player base.
-Enhanced Gameplay: Expect a series of updates aimed at improving gameplay mechanics, visuals, and overall user experience.

We are eager to hear your feedback and work together to make "Broilers" better than ever. Stay tuned for more updates and announcements as we embark on this exciting journey.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm.

Best regards,

The Bloxhill Team

notes.title: Deleting game from Steam
notes.notes:
Unfortunately the game Broilers will be removed from Steam, as the game has not found its audience and I can not support and develop this project.
In honor of the game's removal, there will be a 66% discount starting November 28 (10 am) for 7 days, after which the game will be removed

notes.title: Broilers Demo!
notes.notes: Now you can play a demo version of the game. It does not differ from the normal version, you can also play with other players. However, the demo version can be a temporary solution. The game goes to a kind of free distribution model, where you can buy the full version if you want to support the developer. The demo will be around for at least a few months, and possibly stay forever.
